A studio in Larnaca

Alena Makeup & Nails Artistry is on Trion Ierarchon in Larnaca. Google lists it as women owned. The Google rating is 5.0 across 108 reviews, and the studio replies to them personally. Guests on holiday book a manicure and pedicure next to regulars who have been coming for a year. There is no website of its own: the Google listing shows no website at all.
